name: DialUpSoundz
tagline: Talk a playlist through in your chat app, then save it to Apple Music.
summary: Paste the list your chat assistant gives you. DialUpSoundz finds every song on Apple Music, shows you what it matched, and saves the playlist to your library or plays it right away. That part is free. A one-time Data Layer unlock adds your own record of what you play and what you think of it: ratings, tags and liner notes, recommendations from the Operator, and your data to export and import, all kept on your iPhone.
statusLabel: Coming soon to the App Store
stepsHeading: From a chat to a playlist

steps.title: Talk it through in your chat app
steps.body: Copy the DialUpSoundz prompt into a chat with your assistant. It works with chat assistants like Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini. Talk about moods, eras, deep cuts and what to leave out, then ask for the list.

steps.title: Paste the list
steps.body: Copy the reply and paste it into DialUpSoundz. A plain list such as Artist - Song, one per line, works too.

steps.title: Review the matches
steps.body: Each song, artist or album is looked up on Apple Music. Anything that needs a look is marked, and you can swap versions, preview, reorder or remove.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Nothing is saved until you tap Save. The playlist goes to your Apple Music library with its name and description.

features.title: Playlists from a chat
features.body: Original studio versions are preferred over live, karaoke and cover versions, unless you asked for those. Save it, or play it right here with AirPlay.

features.title: Album lists
features.body: Ask for whole albums instead of songs, and DialUpSoundz matches each one to the album on Apple Music.

features.title: Rate fast
features.body: Work through your most played albums and songs, an artist's records, or anything on Apple Music: stars, love or not, your own tags, and liner notes. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Ask the Operator
features.body: Set up your chat assistant once with your ratings and listening, and ask it for music that fits your taste. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Research and notes
features.body: Dig into an album with the Operator and keep what you learn with it, along with why it was recommended. With the Data Layer.

features.title: Your data, yours to keep
features.body: Browse your listening history, Listen Later and ratings, look inside the JSON, and export or import all of it. The history and charts are early and growing. With the Data Layer.
